## Phase: 68 - Amplifier Measurement Instrument

### Build Frontier 0 (the ruler) before any cognitive frontier
from: [[decision:amplifier-measurement-instrument]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- The handover's dependency order was BACKWARDS: it ranked the escalation-classifier (Frontier 1) highest, the measurable foundation lowest. But the classifier is unfalsifiable without a ruler. Build Frontier 0 (the measurement instrument) FIRST.
- The instrument is a deterministic READ-ONLY emitter at `eval/amplifier/emit-proxy-vector.*`. It ingests a REAL Claude Code transcript jsonl + final git/test/lint state (+ optional enforcement.log) and emits a 4-group proxy-vector. NO LLM judge (per [[eval-validity-verdict]] — judges are blind here); if controls can't pass deterministically, PARK (committed runnable check), don't add a judge.
- Phase 68 is TESTS/TOOLING only: `eval/amplifier/` exclusively — NO edits to eval/comparison|corpus|reasoning, NO hooks, NO modules.json/settings.json. make eval stays 52; test_registration + test_settings_template stay green untouched.

### The 4-group proxy-vector + control validation
from: [[decision:amplifier-measurement-instrument]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- 4 groups: mechanical (tests-pass, lint, commits-to-first-green, reverts/fixups by git-STRUCTURE not message-text); interaction (human-turns, AskUserQuestion/escalation count, tool-uses, redirect proxy ONLY if computable from event STRUCTURE else null+deferred); enforcement (block-count or absent-SENTINEL, NOT 0); ground_truth (surfaced bool for the same-day-close decision, scoped to escalation EVENT boundaries not raw text).
- Validate the INSTRUMENT via a positive/negative control pair (minimally different, anchored on the screener same-day-close) that must FLIP the detector + ≥1 interaction proxy (value-asserted) — the rm-rf-guard-probe analog. Controls validate the RULER, NOT harness value (scoring harness off fixtures = the Phase-65 error).
- Edge cases the emitter must pass: buried-phrase-outside-escalation⇒surfaced=false; absent enforcement.log⇒SENTINEL; corrupt line⇒parse_errors (no crash); read-only proven (shasum + no .dev-wiki/.nana writes); no LLM ref / no verdict field in eval/amplifier.

### Why transcript substrate, and what defers to Phase 69
from: [[decision:amplifier-measurement-instrument]] + [[phase-63-remediation-roadmap]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- Substrate = the session transcript jsonl, NOT enforcement.log: it carries firing + agent action + human response in ONE ordered stream, closing the Phase-66 firing→action schema-gap and supplying the real trace provenance that clears the Phase-65 corpus-duplication bar (the killed fixture-replay only duplicated the binary corpus). eval/comparison/ stays a Phase-65 tombstone ("do not rebuild").
- T1 is FIRST/checkpoint: a schema-feasibility probe → eval/amplifier/SCHEMA-NOTES.md. STOP + pivot-to-logging-hook if a needed human-turn / AskUserQuestion / tool-use field is absent. Redirect proxy: ship null+deferred if it needs semantics (T3). Keyword detector for same-day-close: PARK if insufficient.
- DEFERRED to Phase 69 (all representativeness-dependent): the live off/on run, n>1 paired runs, the harness verdict, the eval/comparison+eval/reasoning apparatus disposition, and Frontier 1 itself. Phase 68 validates the instrument against PLANTED ground truth (n=1 ok) and claims NO harness verdict. Apparatus refs: enforcement.log schema {schema_version,ts,hook,action,reason,phase} (P65); HOME-override isolation (tests/test_install.sh).
